chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya and Fadalah, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:
Concerning a man who falls upon another man and kills him, he عليه السلام said: “There is nothing upon him.” And he عليه السلام said: “Whoever is killed by qisas, there is no diyah for him.”

key_terms.الْقِصَاصُ: retaliatory legal punishment for homicide or injury
key_terms.دِيَةَ: financial blood-compensation paid in cases of killing or injury

ai.seo_question: Is there diyah if a person accidentally falls on someone and kills him, or if someone is killed by qisas?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding unintended killing caused by falling onto another person, stating that no liability is upon the one who fell. It also states that one who is executed through qisas is not entitled to diyah, clarifying limits of financial compensation in homicide law.
